environment: Linux, Xvfb 1440x900, Vulkan Lavapipe; X11 XTest input and MCPBridge.
scope: After creating a parameter-driven cube by UI, changing size to 20 mm, undo/redo, saving and reopening, analysis_measure resolves a face key recorded at 10 mm and returns 399.9999999984629 mm².
limitations: The input driver uses fixed coordinates and is retained as a historical record.
Bridge shared-library source-to-binary provenance was not verified.
One planar cube face is checked live; exact integration and refusal cases have separate automated tests.
Other analysis.measure types are explicitly declined.
